facts.statement: START shall initiate automatic operation when the system is in its initial condition.
facts.quote: URS-F-001 - START shall initiate automatic operation when the system is in its initial condition.

facts.statement: Normal operation shall fill Tank 1 by opening V1.
facts.quote: URS-F-002 - Normal operation shall fill Tank 1 by opening V1.

facts.statement: V1 shall close when Tank 1 reaches the specified high-level limit.
facts.quote: URS-F-003 - V1 shall close when Tank 1 reaches the specified high-level limit.

facts.statement: After a 10 s waiting period, V2 shall open and transfer liquid from Tank 1 to Tank 2.
facts.quote: URS-F-004 - After a 10 s waiting period, V2 shall open and transfer liquid from Tank 1 to Tank 2.

facts.statement: V2 shall close when Tank 1 reaches its minimum operating level.
facts.quote: URS-F-005 - V2 shall close when Tank 1 reaches its minimum operating level.

facts.statement: After a 10 s waiting period, V3 shall open and drain Tank 2.
facts.quote: URS-F-006 - After a 10 s waiting period, V3 shall open and drain Tank 2.

facts.statement: V3 shall close when Tank 2 reaches its minimum operating level.
facts.quote: URS-F-007 - V3 shall close when Tank 2 reaches its minimum operating level.

facts.statement: The automatic process shall continue cyclically unless stopped or shut down.
facts.quote: URS-F-008 - The automatic process shall continue cyclically unless stopped or shut down.

facts.statement: STOP shall close all three valves and suspend automatic operation until another operator command is received.
facts.quote:
URS-M-001 - STOP shall close all three valves and suspend automatic operation until another operator command is
      received.

facts.statement: START after STOP shall continue the process operation rather than force a new empty-cycle initialization.
facts.quote:
URS-M-002 - START after STOP shall continue the process operation rather than force a new empty-cycle
        initialization.

facts.statement: SHUT shall empty both tanks by opening V2 and V3 and shall inhibit V1.
facts.quote: URS-M-003 - SHUT shall empty both tanks by opening V2 and V3 and shall inhibit V1.

facts.statement: When shutdown emptying is achieved, V2 and V3 shall close and the controller shall return to the start configuration.
facts.quote:
URS-M-004 - When shutdown emptying is achieved, V2 and V3 shall close and the controller shall return to the start
       configuration.

facts.statement: Level measurements LT-101 and LT-102 shall be available to PLC-101.
facts.quote: Level measurements LT-101 and LT-102 shall be available to PLC-101.

facts.statement: START, STOP and SHUT are momentary commands.
facts.quote:
START, STOP and SHUT are
 momentary commands.

facts.statement: The supplier shall provide actuators that fail closed on loss of power.
facts.quote:
The supplier shall provide
 actuators that fail closed on loss of power.

facts.statement: Sequence operation, stop/resume behavior and controlled shutdown shall be demonstrated in simulation.
facts.quote: Sequence operation, stop/resume behavior and controlled shutdown shall be demonstrated in simulation.
